note: LEADS.md Part O O8 and Part A A50, CODED, UNTESTED ON A GPU: the verify-window attention with FOUR queries a block (STRATA_ATTN_VWIN=1 + STRATA_ATTN_VWIN_ROWS=4, HIP only, 62 KB LDS, 73 VGPRs, 0 spills from the SDK compile) against two (STRATA_ATTN_VWIN=1, the A50 kernel) and the default. Exact: bit for bit attn_chunk_kernel (check first with qsa_merge_daily_parity, chunk kernels 3 and 5). The answer to the O8 question is in the code: the default chunk kernel gives every query its own block, so a pool row that several rows' selections share is read once per row; VWIN shares it for pairs, ROWS=4 for four. Needs windows of 2+ rows: the short / edit cases run MTP / lookup windows. Screen: promote from 0%, drop below -3%. CONFIRM: --block 3 --warmup 1 --outlier robust --reclaim-max 3 --reps 5 after a screen that promoted an arm.

predict.why: A50's fork number was 48.6 -> 88.9 tok/s at 200K on another card; at 32K with 10-row windows the K/V reuse is partial; a 4-row block holds one workgroup a CU (LDS 62 KB), which can cost more than the saved loads

stop: drop vwin4 if it is below vwin2 on every case
drop any arm below -3% on any case (screen rule)
promote only at >= 2% end to end
